title: Sources: in a London presentation, SpaceXAI says Grok Bot hit 418,000 users as of September 14, up 24% from the week prior; SpaceXAI launched it in mid-August (Edward Ludlow/Bloomberg)
summary: Edward Ludlow / Bloomberg: Sources: in a London presentation, SpaceXAI says Grok Bot hit 418,000 users as of September 14, up 24% from the week prior; SpaceXAI launched it in mid-August — SpaceXAI's Grok Bot artificial intelligence agent has topped 400,000 weekly users roughly a month after it launched …
